summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API focused on enhancing the reliability and reporting capabilities of real-time communication. Key improvements include the introduction of **DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) error handling**, which helps ensure secure peer connection setups, and the implementation of an API for selecting candidate pairs with `RTCIceTransport`, improving connection quality during video calls. These changes, along with improved statistics reporting for outbound and RTP (Real-Time Protocol) streams, enhance the overall performance and stability of WebRTC, making online video conferences more resilient and reliable for users. Additionally, some adjustments to the internal handling of codecs and RTP header extensions streamline operations, which should help developers implement more efficient applications without visible delays.
